notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org evaluating Hosted API for quick proof-of-concept; moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Primary driver: customer-facing chat + semantic search with reranking.

Prospect voice: 'We need consistent p50 latency <200ms for chat and stable throughput during business hours; can't risk noisy neighbors.'

Security asks: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), SOC2 attestation, audit logs forwarded to SIEM, optional customer-managed KMS and US-only data residency. Legal will push back on unlimited liability and lengthy data retention.

Cost sensitivity: medium-high — they want Clear per-token unit economics, recommendations on batching/quantization to meet 75-100k ARR target for year 1.

Model preferences: start with hosted gpt-compatible open models for POC (Llama3-like variants), plan Dedicated on quantized 8-bit variants for cost. Need routing/fallback rules to cheaper variant during peak.

Quote from PM: 'If Redwood can guarantee isolation and a rollback policy per model version we can replace our current vendor.'
